instruction: Use Microsoft Edge Immersive Reader to read the FTC spam-text reporting section. Save the action phrase from each of the three reporting bullets to `answer.txt` on the Desktop, one phrase per line and in webpage order.
gt_steps: Switch to the FTC spam text guidance in Microsoft Edge.
With the article active in Microsoft Edge, press `F9` to enter Immersive Reader.
Scroll to `How To Report Spam Text Messages`.

Enter the following text, one phrase per line:
`forward it to 7726 (SPAM)`
`Report it on the messaging app you use`
`Report it to the FTC at ReportFraud.ftc.gov`
Save the file as `answer.txt` on the Desktop.
